details:
FARMINTEL AI – Intelligence for Every Acre

1. Project Overview

FARMINTEL AI is an AI-powered agricultural decision intelligence platform designed to help farmers and agricultural stakeholders make informed decisions using Earth observation, climate, soil, and agricultural datasets.

The platform addresses the challenge of understanding changing field conditions and making agricultural decisions using information from multiple sources. It brings geospatial mapping, climate intelligence, soil analysis, crop suitability assessment, and agricultural planning into one unified web application.

2. How It Works

Users can select an agricultural field using an interactive map, search for a location, or enter geographic coordinates. The platform uses the selected location to organize relevant environmental and agricultural information.

Its major modules include:

  • Geospatial Field Workspace: Select and visualize agricultural locations.
  • Climate Intelligence: Explore climate conditions and potential environmental risks.
  • Soil Intelligence: Examine available soil properties and field conditions.
  • Crop Suitability: Evaluate crop suitability using available environmental and agricultural features.
  • Rotation Optimizer: Explore crop rotation planning.
  • ML Models: Apply machine-learning models for agricultural decision support.
  • Evidence and Reports: Present information in an accessible format.

3. NASA Earth Science and Supporting Data

The project is designed around Earth observation and environmental information, including NASA POWER and Landsat-derived observations. It also integrates supporting agricultural and geospatial sources such as USDA SSURGO soil information and other relevant public datasets.

These sources help connect field location with environmental conditions and agricultural analysis. Different datasets have different levels of integration and coverage, so results are presented according to the information actually available.

4. Technology Stack

  • Frontend: React, TypeScript, Vite
  • Backend: Python, FastAPI
  • Machine Learning: Scikit-learn and Joblib
  • Geospatial: Rasterio, PyProj, STAC
  • Database: SQLite
  • Mapping: Leaflet and OpenStreetMap
  • Deployment: Vercel and Render
  • Version Control: Git and GitHub

5. Innovation and Impact

FARMINTEL AI combines geospatial visualization, environmental datasets, and machine-learning-based analysis in one agricultural decision-support workspace.

Its goal is to make complex Earth science information easier to understand and use, helping users explore crop suitability, identify potential environmental risks, and support more informed agricultural planning.

6. Pilot Region and Future Scope

The initial pilot focuses on Story County, Iowa, in the US Midwest Corn Belt. The platform is designed to expand to additional agricultural regions and crop types as data coverage, model validation, and regional testing improve.

Our long-term vision is to make Earth science data more accessible for sustainable and climate-resilient agriculture.
